label: Wings That Graced the Sky: B

lines.text: Isabel's right shoulder and arm are swallowed by a surge of crimson light.
Her flight falters as parts of her upper body melt away in an instant.

lines.speaker: isabel
lines.text: Argh...!

lines.speaker: harran
lines.text: We are nearly there. Do hang in a little longer.

lines.speaker: isabel
lines.text: I will...!
Isabel pushes her speed even further.
She feels it—her limit approaching fast—until control slips away.
A torrent of crimson light crashes down.
Then, the realization hits: her lower half is gone,
and her core power drops precipitously.

lines.speaker: isabel
lines.text: Harran!

lines.speaker: harran
lines.text: Leave the rest to me.

lines.speaker: isabel
lines.text: Ahhhhhh!
With what is certain to be her final burst of speed,
Isabel surges into the downpour of crimson light.
Twisting her body mid-flight, she launches Harran into the air.
Harran lands on the space station's outer wall.
Should she turn back?
No, only regret and rage wait there.
Harran swings her scythe, breaking through the station's outer wall, and leaps into the crack.
Isabel watches. Once she's sure Harran has made it, she gently closes her eyes.
Then, the crimson light comes for her, in endless streams.

lines.speaker: isabel
lines.text: Darling.

lines.speaker: isabel
lines.text: To see you once more...
The crimson light engulfs Isabel.

lines.speaker: harran
lines.text: What a squalid, damp place.

lines.speaker: harran
lines.text: Hehe, how perfectly it suits a hideous wretch like you.
Harran swings her scythe.
Powder scatters in the air.

lines.speaker: harran
lines.text: Be grateful to my comrades fighting beneath you.

lines.speaker: harran
lines.text: I would have delighted in tormenting you further, but that would put their lives at risk.

lines.speaker: harran
lines.text: A pity... but I shall end this swiftly.
The powder spreads further.
Sparks jump and crackle across the space, and an ominous sound reverberates all around.

lines.speaker: harran
lines.text: This is a self-replicating, predatory virus I prepared just for you.

lines.speaker: harran
lines.text: The more foolishly large you are, the more there is to feed on, and the more ferociously it multiplies.

lines.speaker: harran
lines.text: Now then,

lines.speaker: harran
lines.text: fall.

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: Ah, Your Highness! Methinks the Nayutas in the area have dwindled greatly!

lines.speaker: crown
lines.text: Then the spice station will fall soon.

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: 'Tis the space station, Your Highness! And yet, after all this time, naught has happened...!

lines.speaker: crown
lines.text: Believe in them, Chime.

lines.speaker: crown
lines.text: They have placed their very lives on the line to defeat the Queen.

lines.speaker: crown
lines.text: And when one stakes life itself, miracles are wont to follow.

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: Understood! I, Chime, have foolishly imagined defeat and spouted nonsense!

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: I shall trust you and fight!

lines.speaker: crown
lines.text: Yes, let us do precisely that.
Crown and Chime ride atop Trombe, tearing through the battlefield with unstoppable force.
With each sweep of her spear, Crown shatters and pierces any Rapture that dares to block their path,
while Chime hurls bomb after bomb, sending enemies flying in all directions.
Crimson light rains down from above, but not a single one touches Trombe.

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: Your Highness!

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: Indivilia lieth before us!
At the end of the rapidly changing scenery, Indivilia looks at Crown with a smile.

lines.speaker: crown
lines.text: Shall we hold her here?

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: All righty!

lines.speaker: crown
lines.text: Hold on tight, Chime. We ride at full speed.

lines.speaker: crown
lines.text: Forward, Trombe!
Trombe slams its hooves harder into the ground, surging forward with explosive force.
The acceleration is so great, the surrounding landscape dissolves into a blur.
In that split second, a massive chunk of metal crashes down in Trombe's path.
The impact sends a deep tremor through the earth, and thick dust billows up in its wake.
Crown's gaze snaps skyward.
Beyond the blood-red clouds, rusted, broken fragments of steel rain down like a storm.
The Queen is descending—slowly, steadily, drawing closer to the surface.
And then, all at once, the relentless barrage of crimson light comes to a halt.

lines.speaker: crown
lines.text: It seems it has fallen.

lines.speaker: kilo
lines.text: We did it!

lines.speaker: talos
lines.text: Space station neutralized.

lines.speaker: talos
lines.text: Initiating deathblow sequence.

lines.speaker: crown
lines.text: ... Do remind me, what was that again?

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: Fall back! We must retreat, Your Highness!

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: Should we be ensnared, all is lost!

lines.speaker: crown
lines.text: Ah, so that was the plan.

lines.speaker: crown
lines.text: Very well. Fall back.
*Slash!*
The chunk of steel in Trombe's way is sliced in half and crashes to the ground.
From beyond the wreckage, Indivilia's tail comes whipping forward,
aimed directly at Chime's neck.

lines.speaker: indivilia
lines.text: There is still a matter of revenge I must see through.
Crown turns sharply, thrusting her spear up just in time to shield Chime's side.

lines.speaker: indivilia
lines.text: Heh...! Just as I thought...!
Indivilia launches a relentless assault on Chime.
The air cracks with piercing shrieks as blades and spears collide in a clash of metal.
Crown intercepts every strike, shielding Chime without fail.

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: U-ugh...!

lines.speaker: crown
lines.text: Worry not, Chime. I will ensure you are safe.

lines.speaker: indivilia
lines.text: Ah, yes! You are truly suited to die for others!

lines.speaker: indivilia
lines.text: Continue shouldering their lives and missions until your death!
*Claaang!*
Indivilia's blade gains terrifying speed and locks onto Chime like a predator, relentless in its pursuit.

lines.speaker: crown
lines.text: Hrnggh...!
Chime curses herself for being powerless as the battle raged on before her.
And yet, at the same time, she feels a flicker of relief
as she watches the king's back, standing before her and blocking everything.
*Swoooosh!*
Indivilia's tail sweeps in a vicious arc, aiming not at Crown, but at Chime behind her.
It's a devastating blow. Crown sees it coming and knows that if she can block this, the moment to counter will be hers.
*Clang!*
Crown's spear meets the tail's blade.
As she adjusts her stance for a swift retaliation, a strange sensation creeps over her.
Her body feels sluggish.

lines.speaker: indivilia
lines.text: I've been sprinkling the Alva particles you like, letting them seep in.

lines.speaker: indivilia
lines.text: Does it please you?

lines.speaker: crown
lines.text: Chime! Retreat...!

lines.speaker: indivilia
lines.text: It's already too late.
Indivilia's tail lashes toward Chime once more.
But Crown steps in to block it.

lines.speaker: indivilia
lines.text: Indeed. I expected you would do that.
The tail, once sweeping horizontally through the air, suddenly shifts course in a heartbeat.
Its blade at the tip surges skyward, then crashes down with lethal force.
Indivilia's strike buries itself into Crown's shoulder,
carving a ruthless path downward.
The blade doesn't stop until it has slashed clean through to her waist—only then does it tear free from her body.
At that very moment, Indivilia steps back, putting distance between them.

lines.speaker: crown
lines.text: *Cough*

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: Your Hiiighness!

lines.speaker: indivilia
lines.text: Hehe... Ahahaha!

lines.speaker: indivilia
lines.text: As I thought, that foolish power of yours is no longer yours to command.

lines.speaker: indivilia
lines.text: And congratulations.

lines.speaker: indivilia
lines.text: To lay down your life for another... Surely, there is no greater honor for you.

lines.speaker: kilo_op_r
lines.text: Arrgghh!
With a sharp kick, T.A.L.O.S. sends the Rapture he'd been facing flying, then charges straight at Indivilia.
She lowers her stance with a smile, calm and unfazed.
At that moment, Trombe slams into T.A.L.O.S.

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: We shall retreat!

lines.speaker: kilo_op_r
lines.text: Crown! Crowwwn!

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: Rapunzel is here! She shall save her at all costs!

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: Retreeeeaaat!

lines.speaker: kilo_op_r
lines.text: Ack...! Uuuuugh...!
Indivilia casts a glare over her shoulder at Trombe and T.A.L.O.S., who are trying to retreat.

lines.speaker: indivilia
lines.text: Preposterous.

lines.speaker: indivilia
lines.text: Who gave you leave to retreat?
Just as Indivilia is just about to dash after lowering her stance,
something in the corner of her eye catches her attention, and she stops.

lines.speaker: indivilia
lines.text: ... What, exactly, is that?
Marian looks to the sky.
A sky stained in crimson.
Fragments of steel pour down like rain.
She let her gaze drift to the battlefield.
To the Nayutas who have fallen. To those still dying.
To Isabel and Harran who are risking their lives.
To the Nikkes of the Crown Kingdom letting out battle cries as they fight.
To the Raptures...
dying by the dozens.
Everything Marian holds dear is locked in a desperate battle to the death.
She feels a sorrow so heavy it presses on her chest.
At the same time, a surge of anger begins to boil within her.
She lifts her head once more to the sky.
Her eyes fall on the thing suspended upon the wires stretched across the clouds.
The Queen watches the carnage below with cold indifference.

lines.speaker: marian_q
lines.text: ... It's you.

lines.speaker: marian_q
lines.text: So it really was you.
Black light bursts out from Marian's body.
Black particles scatter into the air as the ground shakes beneath her.

lines.speaker: marian_q
lines.text: Because of you...!

lines.speaker: marian_q
lines.text: Because of you, we!
Black light bursts forth.
Instinctively, Indivilia takes a step back.
All of a sudden, a massive figure appears on the battlefield.
She knows exactly what it is—more than anyone.

lines.speaker: indivilia
lines.text: Transformation...!
